title: Validate Python Worker dependency compatibility
description: Verify that the existing backend dependencies work in Cloudflare Python Workers or identify minimal adaptations. Focus on FastAPI, Pydantic, httpx, BeautifulSoup, lxml, and any runtime APIs used by ingestion.
acceptance_criteria: Local Worker build/preview either succeeds or produces documented incompatibilities; any required dependency/config changes are made; backend tests still pass; known Python Workers beta limitations are captured in the issue notes.
notes: 2026-05-26: Validated Cloudflare Python Worker compatibility path. Updated runtime contract to Python >=3.12, Docker base to python:3.12-slim, added Python Workers tooling (workers-py from current GitHub CLI package and workers-runtime-sdk), and added disable_python_external_sdk alongside python_workers to avoid the stale ASGI bridge failure. FastAPI, Pydantic, httpx, BeautifulSoup, and lxml import successfully with uv. npx wrangler deploy --dry-run succeeds and includes the Expo assets/API Worker bundle. Local preview is still blocked by tooling: uv run pywrangler dev fails before bundling because Node v26 rejects Pyodide's --experimental-wasm-stack-switching flag; raw npx wrangler dev starts Python but does not vendor pyproject dependencies, so it fails with ModuleNotFoundError: fastapi. Backend tests pass: uv run pytest => 145 passed, 1 datetime.utcnow deprecation warning. Known beta limitation: package bundling/local preview requires pywrangler plus a Node/runtime combination compatible with Pyodide's wasm stack-switching flag.
close_reason: Validated Worker dependency compatibility. Added Python 3.12/Python Workers tooling/config, deploy dry-run passes, backend tests pass, and local preview blockers are documented in the issue notes.
